topics.definition: Containers package applications with their dependencies into lightweight, isolated environments.
topics.example: Running a web app in Docker
tips: Containers share the host OS kernel.

topics.definition: Docker is a platform for building, running and managing containers.
tips: Docker is the most widely used container platform.

topics.definition: A Docker image is a read-only template used to create containers.
A container is a running instance of a Docker image.
tips: Containers are isolated from each other.

topics.definition: A Dockerfile contains instructions for building a Docker image.
tips: Use official base images when possible.

topics.definition: Docker Compose defines and runs multi-container applications using a YAML file.
Containers share the host OS while virtual machines include a complete guest OS.
tips: Containers start faster and use fewer resources.

topics.definition: Use minimal images, scan for vulnerabilities and keep containers updated.
tips: Do not run containers as root.
